last_experiment.hypothesis: The model bridge injects AI_IN as soon as its TCP socket connects, but the guest does not poll serial input until after it emits AI_STATUS:READY; this ordering can lose the injected request.
last_experiment.action: Updated .aether/tools/model_bridge.py to wait for the exact guest AI_STATUS:READY line before sending AI_STATUS:ACTIVE or injected input.
evidence: Evolution run 37319443981 artifact: model bridge logged AI_STATUS:CONNECTED, AI_STATUS:ACTIVE, and AI_IN, then timed out without any AI_REQ, AI_RES, or AI_ACK.
The same artifact's guest serial log reached [DESKTOP] starting (no Ring3).
kernel/src/desktop.rs emits AI_STATUS:READY immediately before entering the loop that calls ai_transport_poll; the bridge previously sent input before waiting for this marker.
last_experiment.result: The readiness gate is implemented. Local Python execution was unavailable in this environment, so syntax and end-to-end behavior remain unverified pending PR Actions.
last_experiment.next_bounded_step: Run the existing Aether evolution QEMU workflow on the PR and verify the bidirectional bridge assertions; do not make another code change before inspecting that evidence.

last_experience.conclusion: QEMU validation did not satisfy all required startup markers; retain the failure as bounded experience.
